category_title: Students who actively distance themselves from non-reading family environments
student_description: Demetrius is a polite, highly motivated student who consistently struggles in traditional English classes that rely on whole-class assigned texts due to a lack of early reading models at home. He uniquely requires complete autonomy in text selection, personalized goal-setting, and a supportive reading community to build his identity as a successful reader.

criteria.rationale: Traditional uniform assessments fail Demetrius; he requires an assessment model built around his self-selected reading to maintain his motivation and passing grades.
criteria.check: The long-term plan replaces standardized, whole-class text assessments with individualized evaluations, conferences, or reflections based on the texts Demetrius chooses to read.

criteria.rationale: Demetrius actively distances himself from his non-reading family environment and needs a supportive, choice-respecting peer community to validate his developing identity as a reader.
criteria.check: The long-term plan includes strategies to connect Demetrius with a community of peers, mentors, or groups who share and respect individual reading choices.
